podcast.body: This is the title track from The Middle Class's 1979 EP, which ran for less than 5 minutes total across four songs and marked an early classic of West Coast hardcore. "This is the title track, and it's called Out of Vote."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This is the title track from The Middle Class's 1979 debut EP, which is considered the first hardcore record from the American West Coast. The rapid-fire nature of the song and EP (4 songs in under 5 minutes) exemplified the new, stripped-down punk sound. "This is the title track, and it's called Out of Vote."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
